description: Read your ParlayX account and the prediction markets from an MCP client.
name: com.parlayx/mcp

environmentVariables.description: The key id issued with your ParlayX signing keypair.
environmentVariables.name: PARLAYX_KEY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Your Ed25519 private key seed, 64 lowercase hex characters. It stays on your machine.
environmentVariables.name: PARLAYX_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the four order tools. They stay hidden without it, and also require a key carrying the trade capability.
environmentVariables.name: PARLAYX_MCP_ALLOW_TRADING
